proof: Convert coordinate additive maps to an integer-multilinear map. Extend through PiTensorProduct.lift and the canonical direct-sum degree projection. Show every Steinberg generator multiplied by arbitrary pure tensors vanishes: in the selected degree use the adjacent Steinberg condition, otherwise the degree projection is zero. Tensor extensionality extends the vanishing to arbitrary left and right factors. Native TwoSidedIdeal span-as-additive-closure gives annihilation of the entire ideal. Descend via the native additive congruence and restrict to the native homogeneous subgroup. Symbol evaluation is exact and prior native extensionality supplies uniqueness.
